dominant.name: whiteboard_canvas
dominant.role: Whiteboard drawing surface and primary canvas background

deep.name: deep_purple
deep.role: Room wall, board outer frame, title bars, card headers and primary outlines

mid.name: mid_purple
mid.role: Supporting shapes, arrows, accents and secondary containers

text.name: dark_purple_text
text.role: High-contrast text on whiteboard and cards (minimum 4.5:1 WCAG)

accent.name: warm_amber
accent.role: Outline, underline, or small highlight on the one key item per scene only (never full card fill)

danger_blocked.name: red
danger_blocked.role: Danger, blocked, warning, error loop (used only in danger scenes)
